segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: My feet are driving me crazy.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Can you give me something to fix it quickly?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Before I give you any recommendations, can I ask a few questions?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Can I have your name, age, and medical number?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: My age is 50 years and I am 60 kgs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Have you noticed any unusual symptoms such as swelling of the skin or fever?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Are you currently taking any prescription medicines or over-the-counter medicines?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Based on the information given, I believe you are having tinea because you wear shoes all day for work.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Apply a thin layer onto the affected areas, which is your toes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Please continue for two weeks after the symptoms subside.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: Do you have any questions for me?
